verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֨ר יְהוָ֤ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁה֙ לֵ֣ךְ עֲלֵ֣ה מִזֶּ֔ה אַתָּ֣ה וְהָעָ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֶֽעֱלִ֖יתָ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם אֶל־ הָאָ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נִ֠שְׁבַּעְתִּי לְאַבְרָהָ֨ם לְיִצְחָ֤ק וּֽלְיַעֲקֹב֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר לְזַרְעֲךָ֖ אֶתְּנֶֽנָּה׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḏab·bêr Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh lêḵ ‘ă·lêh miz·zeh ’at·tāh wə·hā·‘ām ’ă·šer he·‘ĕ·lî·ṯā mê·’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim ’el- hā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer niš·ba‘·tî lə·’aḇ·rā·hām lə·yiṣ·ḥāq ū·lə·ya·‘ă·qōḇ lê·mōr lə·zar·‘ă·ḵā ’et·tə·nen·nāh
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to Moses Leave this place you and the people you brought up out of the land of Egypt and go to the land that I promised to Abraham Isaac and Jacob when I said I will give it to your descendants
verses.literalPt: Disse mais Jeová a Moisés: Vai, sobe deste lugar, tu e o povo que fizeste subir da terra do Egito para a terra a respeito da qual jurei a Abraão, Isaque e Jacó, dizendo: À tua posteridade, a darei.

verses.original: וְשָׁלַחְתִּ֥י לְפָנֶ֖יךָ מַלְאָ֑ךְ וְגֵֽרַשְׁתִּ֗י אֶת־ הַֽכְּנַעֲנִי֙ הָֽאֱמֹרִ֔י וְהַֽחִתִּי֙ וְהַפְּרִזִּ֔י הַחִוִּ֖י וְהַיְבוּסִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·šā·laḥ·tî lə·p̄ā·ne·ḵā mal·’āḵ wə·ḡê·raš·tî ’eṯ- hak·kə·na·‘ă·nî hā·’ĕ·mō·rî wə·ha·ḥit·tî wə·hap·pə·riz·zî ha·ḥiw·wî wə·hay·ḇū·sî
verses.literal: And I will send an angel before you and I will drive out the Canaanites Amorites Hittites Perizzites Hivites and Jebusites
verses.literalPt: Enviarei um anjo adiante de ti; e lançarei fora os cananeus, os amorreus, os heteus, os perizeus, os heveus e os jebuseus.

verses.original: אֶל־ אֶ֛רֶץ זָבַ֥ת חָלָ֖ב וּדְבָ֑שׁ כִּי֩ לֹ֨א אֶֽעֱלֶ֜ה בְּקִרְבְּךָ֗ כִּ֤י עַם־ קְשֵׁה־ עֹ֙רֶף֙ אַ֔תָּה פֶּן־ אֲכֶלְךָ֖ בַּדָּֽרֶךְ׃
verses.transliteration: ’el- ’e·reṣ zā·ḇaṯ ḥā·lāḇ ū·ḏə·ḇāš kî lō ’e·‘ĕ·leh bə·qir·bə·ḵā kî ‘am- qə·šêh- ‘ō·rep̄ ’at·tāh pen- ’ă·ḵel·ḵā bad·dā·reḵ
verses.literal: Go up to a land flowing with milk and honey But I will not go with you because you are a stiff-necked . . . people otherwise I might destroy you on the way
verses.literalPt: Sobe para uma terra que mana leite e mel. Eu não subirei no meio de ti, porque és povo de cerviz dura; para que não te consuma eu no caminho.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁמַ֣ע הָעָ֗ם אֶת־ הַדָּבָ֥ר הָרָ֛ע הַזֶּ֖ה וַיִּתְאַבָּ֑לוּ וְלֹא־ שָׁ֛תוּ אִ֥ישׁ עֶדְי֖וֹ עָלָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·ma‘ hā·‘ām ’eṯ- had·dā·ḇār hā·rā‘ haz·zeh way·yiṯ·’ab·bā·lū wə·lō- šā·ṯū ’îš ‘eḏ·yōw ‘ā·lāw
verses.literal: When the people heard this bad news they went into mourning and no one put on any of his jewelry . . .
verses.literalPt: Ouvindo o povo essas más notícias, pôs-se a prantear; e ninguém vestiu os seus atavios.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֗ה אֱמֹ֤ר אֶל־ בְּנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אַתֶּ֣ם עַם־ קְשֵׁה־ עֹ֔רֶף רֶ֧גַע אֶחָ֛ד אֶֽעֱלֶ֥ה בְקִרְבְּךָ֖ וְכִלִּיתִ֑יךָ וְעַתָּ֗ה הוֹרֵ֤ד עֶדְיְךָ֙ מֵֽעָלֶ֔יךָ וְאֵדְעָ֖ה מָ֥ה אֶֽעֱשֶׂה־ לָּֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh ’ĕ·mōr ’el- bə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl ’at·tem ‘am- qə·šêh- ‘ō·rep̄ re·ḡa‘ ’e·ḥāḏ ’e·‘ĕ·leh ḇə·qir·bə·ḵā wə·ḵil·lî·ṯî·ḵā wə·‘at·tāh hō·w·rêḏ ‘eḏ·yə·ḵā mê·‘ā·le·ḵā wə·’ê·ḏə·‘āh māh ’e·‘ĕ·śeh- lāḵ
verses.literal: For the LORD had said to Moses Tell . . . the Israelites . . . You are a stiff-necked . . . people If I should go with you for a single moment I would destroy you Now take off your jewelry . . . and I will decide what to do with you
verses.literalPt: Pois Jeová disse a Moisés: Dize aos filhos de Israel: Tu és um povo de cerviz dura. Se por um só momento eu subir no meio de ti, te consumirei; portanto, tira de ti os atavios, para que eu saiba o que te hei de fazer.

verses.original: וַיִּֽתְנַצְּל֧וּ בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל אֶת־ עֶדְיָ֖ם מֵהַ֥ר חוֹרֵֽב׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiṯ·naṣ·ṣə·lū ḇə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl ’eṯ- ‘eḏ·yām mê·har ḥō·w·rêḇ
verses.literal: So the Israelites . . . stripped themselves of their jewelry from Mount Horeb onward
verses.literalPt: Então, os filhos de Israel tiraram de si os seus atavios desde o monte Horebe em diante.

verses.original: וּמֹשֶׁה֩ יִקַּ֨ח אֶת־ הָאֹ֜הֶל וְנָֽטָה־ ל֣וֹ׀ מִח֣וּץ לַֽמַּחֲנֶ֗ה הַרְחֵק֙ מִן־ הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֔ה וְקָ֥רָא ל֖וֹ אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וְהָיָה֙ כָּל־ מְבַקֵּ֣שׁ יְהוָ֔ה יֵצֵא֙ אֶל־ אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד אֲשֶׁ֖ר מִח֥וּץ לַֽמַּחֲנֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mō·šeh yiq·qaḥ ’eṯ- hā·’ō·hel wə·nā·ṭāh- lōw mi·ḥūṣ lam·ma·ḥă·neh har·ḥêq min- ham·ma·ḥă·neh wə·qā·rā lōw ’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ wə·hā·yāh kāl- mə·ḇaq·qêš Yah·weh yê·ṣê ’el- ’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ ’ă·šer mi·ḥūṣ lam·ma·ḥă·neh
verses.literal: Now Moses used to take the tent and pitch it . . . . . . at a distance outside the camp He called it the Tent of Meeting and anyone inquiring of the LORD would go to the Tent of Meeting outside the camp
verses.literalPt: Ora, Moisés costumava tomar a tenda e armá-la fora do arraial, bem longe do arraial; e chamou-lhe a tenda da revelação. Todo aquele que buscava a Jeová saía à tenda da revelação, que estava fora do arraial.

verses.original: וְהָיָ֗ה כְּצֵ֤את מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶל־ הָאֹ֔הֶל יָק֙וּמוּ֙ כָּל־ הָעָ֔ם וְנִ֨צְּב֔וּ אִ֖ישׁ פֶּ֣תַח אָהֳל֑וֹ וְהִבִּ֙יטוּ֙ אַחֲרֵ֣י מֹשֶׁ֔ה עַד־ בֹּא֖וֹ הָאֹֽהֱלָה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh kə·ṣêṯ mō·šeh ’el- hā·’ō·hel yā·qū·mū kāl- hā·‘ām wə·niṣ·ṣə·ḇū ’îš pe·ṯaḥ ’ā·ho·lōw wə·hib·bî·ṭū ’a·ḥă·rê mō·šeh ‘aḏ- bō·’ōw hā·’ō·hĕ·lāh
verses.literal: Then whenever Moses went out to the tent all the people . . . would stand at the entrances to their own tents and watch . . . Moses until he entered the tent
verses.literalPt: Quando Moisés saía fora, à tenda, levantava-se todo o povo e ficava em pé, cada um à entrada da sua tenda e via a Moisés pelas costas, até entrar ele na tenda.

verses.original: וְהָיָ֗ה כְּבֹ֤א מֹשֶׁה֙ הָאֹ֔הֱלָה יֵרֵד֙ עַמּ֣וּד הֶֽעָנָ֔ן וְעָמַ֖ד פֶּ֣תַח הָאֹ֑הֶל וְדִבֶּ֖ר עִם־ מֹשֶֽׁה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh kə·ḇō mō·šeh hā·’ō·hĕ·lāh yê·rêḏ ‘am·mūḏ he·‘ā·nān wə·‘ā·maḏ pe·ṯaḥ hā·’ō·hel wə·ḏib·ber ‘im- mō·šeh
verses.literal: As Moses entered the tent the pillar of cloud would come down and remain at the entrance and the LORD would speak with Moses
verses.literalPt: Entrando Moisés na Tenda, descia a coluna de nuvem e parava à entrada da tenda; e Jeová falava com Moisés.

verses.original: וְרָאָ֤ה כָל־ הָעָם֙ אֶת־ עַמּ֣וּד הֶֽעָנָ֔ן עֹמֵ֖ד פֶּ֣תַח הָאֹ֑הֶל וְקָ֤ם כָּל־ הָעָם֙ וְהִֽשְׁתַּחֲוּ֔וּ אִ֖ישׁ פֶּ֥תַח אָהֳלֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·rā·’āh ḵāl hā·‘ām ’eṯ- ‘am·mūḏ he·‘ā·nān ‘ō·mêḏ pe·ṯaḥ hā·’ō·hel wə·qām kāl- hā·‘ām wə·hiš·ta·ḥăw·wū ’îš pe·ṯaḥ ’ā·ho·lōw
verses.literal: When all the people saw the pillar of cloud standing at the entrance to the tent they . . . would stand up and worship each one at the entrance to his own tent
verses.literalPt: Viu todo o povo a coluna de nuvem que estacionava à entrada da tenda; todo o povo levantou-se e adorou, cada um à entrada da sua tenda.

verses.original: וְדִבֶּ֨ר יְהוָ֤ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁה֙ פָּנִ֣ים אֶל־ פָּנִ֔ים כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר יְדַבֵּ֥ר אִ֖ישׁ אֶל־ רֵעֵ֑הוּ וְשָׁב֙ אֶל־ הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֔ה וּמְשָׁ֨רְת֜וֹ יְהוֹשֻׁ֤עַ בִּן־ נוּן֙ נַ֔עַר לֹ֥א יָמִ֖ישׁ מִתּ֥וֹךְ הָאֹֽהֶל׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·ḏib·ber Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh pā·nîm ’el- pā·nîm ka·’ă·šer yə·ḏab·bêr ’îš ’el- rê·‘ê·hū wə·šāḇ ’el- ham·ma·ḥă·neh ū·mə·šā·rə·ṯōw yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘ bin- nūn na·‘ar lō yā·mîš mit·tō·wḵ hā·’ō·hel
verses.literal: Thus the LORD would speak to Moses face to face as a man speaks to his friend Then Moses would return to the camp but his young assistant Joshua son of Nun would not leave the tent
verses.literalPt: Falava Jeová a Moisés cara a cara, como um homem fala ao seu amigo. Depois, voltou Moisés ao arraial; porém o moço Josué, seu servidor, filho de Num, não se apartava da tenda.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֜ה אֶל־ יְהוָ֗ה רְ֠אֵה אַתָּ֞ה אֹמֵ֤ר אֵלַי֙ הַ֚עַל אֶת־ הָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֔ה וְאַתָּה֙ לֹ֣א הֽוֹדַעְתַּ֔נִי אֵ֥ת אֲשֶׁר־ תִּשְׁלַ֖ח עִמִּ֑י וְאַתָּ֤ה אָמַ֙רְתָּ֙ יְדַעְתִּ֣יךָֽ בְשֵׁ֔ם וְגַם־ מָצָ֥אתָ חֵ֖ן בְּעֵינָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer mō·šeh ’el- Yah·weh rə·’êh ’at·tāh ’ō·mêr ’ê·lay ha·‘al ’eṯ- hā·‘ām haz·zeh wə·’at·tāh lō hō·w·ḏa‘·ta·nî ’êṯ ’ă·šer- tiš·laḥ ‘im·mî wə·’at·tāh ’ā·mar·tā yə·ḏa‘·tî·ḵā ḇə·šêm wə·ḡam- mā·ṣā·ṯā ḥên bə·‘ê·nāy
verses.literal: Then Moses said to the LORD Look You have been telling me . . . Lead this people up but You have not let me know whom You will send with me Yet You have said I know you by name and you have found favor in My sight
verses.literalPt: Moisés disse a Jeová: Eis que tu me dizes: Faze subir a este povo; e não me declaras quem hás de enviar comigo. Contudo, tu disseste: Conheço-te pelo teu nome, também achaste graça aos meus olhos.

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֡ה אִם־ נָא֩ מָצָ֨אתִי חֵ֜ן בְּעֵינֶ֗יךָ הוֹדִעֵ֤נִי נָא֙ אֶת־ דְּרָכֶ֔ךָ וְאֵדָ֣עֲךָ֔ לְמַ֥עַן אֶמְצָא־ חֵ֖ן בְּעֵינֶ֑יךָ וּרְאֵ֕ה כִּ֥י עַמְּךָ֖ הַגּ֥וֹי הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh ’im- nā mā·ṣā·ṯî ḥên bə·‘ê·ne·ḵā hō·w·ḏi·‘ê·nî nā ’eṯ- də·rā·ḵe·ḵā wə·’ê·ḏā·‘ă·ḵā lə·ma·‘an ’em·ṣā- ḥên bə·‘ê·ne·ḵā ū·rə·’êh kî ‘am·mə·ḵā hag·gō·w haz·zeh
verses.literal: Now if indeed I have found favor in Your sight please let me know Your ways that I may know You . . . and find favor in Your sight Remember that this nation is Your people
verses.literalPt: Agora, se achei graça aos teus olhos, mostra-me neste momento os teus caminhos, para que eu te conheça, a fim de achar eu graça aos teus olhos; e considera que esta nação é teu povo.

verses.original: וַיֹּאמַ֑ר פָּנַ֥י יֵלֵ֖כוּ וַהֲנִחֹ֥תִי לָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mar pā·nay yê·lê·ḵū wa·hă·ni·ḥō·ṯî lāḵ
verses.literal: And the LORD answered My Presence will go with you and I will give you rest
verses.literalPt: Respondeu-lhe: A minha face irá contigo, e eu te darei descanso.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֖אמֶר אֵלָ֑יו אִם־ אֵ֤ין פָּנֶ֙יךָ֙ הֹלְכִ֔ים אַֽל־ תַּעֲלֵ֖נוּ מִזֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ê·lāw ’im- ’ên pā·ne·ḵā hō·lə·ḵîm ’al- ta·‘ă·lê·nū miz·zeh
verses.literal: If Your Presence does not go with us Moses replied do not lead us up from here
verses.literalPt: Disse-lhe Moisés: Se a tua face não for comigo, não nos faças subir deste lugar.

verses.original: וּבַמֶּ֣ה׀ יִוָּדַ֣ע אֵפ֗וֹא כִּֽי־ מָצָ֨אתִי חֵ֤ן בְּעֵינֶ֙יךָ֙ אֲנִ֣י וְעַמֶּ֔ךָ הֲל֖וֹא בְּלֶכְתְּךָ֣ עִמָּ֑נוּ וְנִפְלֵ֙ינוּ֙ אֲנִ֣י וְעַמְּךָ֔ מִכָּ֨ל־ הָעָ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־ פְּנֵ֥י הָאֲדָמָֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇam·meh yiw·wā·ḏa‘ ’ê·p̄ō·w kî- mā·ṣā·ṯî ḥên bə·‘ê·ne·ḵā ’ă·nî wə·‘am·me·ḵā hă·lō·w bə·leḵ·tə·ḵā ‘im·mā·nū wə·nip̄·lē·nū ’ă·nî wə·‘am·mə·ḵā mik·kāl hā·‘ām ’ă·šer ‘al- pə·nê hā·’ă·ḏā·māh
verses.literal: For how then can it be known . . . that Your people and I have found favor in Your sight unless You go with us How else will we . . . be distinguished from all the other people on the face of the earth
verses.literalPt: Pois como se poderá saber que achamos graça aos teus olhos, eu e teu povo? Porventura, não é em andares tu conosco, de modo que somos separados, eu e teu povo, de todos os povos que se acham sobre a face da terra?

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֔ה גַּ֣ם אֶת־ הַדָּבָ֥ר הַזֶּ֛ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבַּ֖רְתָּ אֶֽעֱשֶׂ֑ה כִּֽי־ מָצָ֤אתָ חֵן֙ בְּעֵינַ֔י וָאֵדָעֲךָ֖ בְּשֵֽׁם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh gam ’eṯ- had·dā·ḇār haz·zeh ’ă·šer dib·bar·tā ’e·‘ĕ·śeh kî- mā·ṣā·ṯā ḥên bə·‘ê·nay wā·’ê·ḏā·‘ă·ḵā bə·šêm
verses.literal: So the LORD said to Moses I will do this very thing you have asked for you have found favor in My sight and I know you by name
verses.literalPt: Disse Jeová a Moisés: Farei também isso que disseste, porque achaste graça aos meus olhos, e te conheço pelo teu nome.

verses.original: וַיֹּאמַ֑ר הַרְאֵ֥נִי נָ֖א אֶת־ כְּבֹדֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mar har·’ê·nî nā ’eṯ- kə·ḇō·ḏe·ḵā
verses.literal: Then Moses said Please show me Your glory
verses.literalPt: Prosseguiu Moisés: Mostra-me a tua glória.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר אֲנִ֨י אַעֲבִ֤יר כָּל־ טוּבִי֙ עַל־ פָּנֶ֔יךָ וְקָרָ֧אתִֽי בְשֵׁ֛ם יְהוָ֖ה לְפָנֶ֑יךָ וְחַנֹּתִי֙ אֶת־ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָחֹ֔ן וְרִחַמְתִּ֖י אֶת־ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲרַחֵֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ă·nî ’a·‘ă·ḇîr kāl- ṭū·ḇî ‘al- pā·ne·ḵā wə·qā·rā·ṯî ḇə·šêm Yah·weh lə·p̄ā·ne·ḵā wə·ḥan·nō·ṯî ’eṯ- ’ă·šer ’ā·ḥōn wə·ri·ḥam·tî ’eṯ- ’ă·šer ’ă·ra·ḥêm
verses.literal: I will cause all My goodness to pass before you the LORD replied and I will proclaim My name the LORD in your presence I will have mercy on whom I have mercy and I will have compassion on whom I have compassion
verses.literalPt: Respondeu-lhe: Farei passar toda a minha bondade diante de ti e te proclamarei o nome de Jeová; terei misericórdia de quem eu tiver misericórdia e me compadecerei de quem eu me compadecer.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֕אמֶר לֹ֥א תוּכַ֖ל לִרְאֹ֣ת אֶת־ פָּנָ֑י כִּ֛י לֹֽא־ יִרְאַ֥נִי הָאָדָ֖ם וָחָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer lō ṯū·ḵal lir·’ōṯ ’eṯ- pā·nāy kî lō- yir·’a·nî hā·’ā·ḏām wā·ḥāy
verses.literal: But He added You cannot . . . see My face for no one can see Me and live
verses.literalPt: Continuou: Não poderás ver a minha face, porque o homem não pode ver a minha face e viver.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוָ֔ה הִנֵּ֥ה מָק֖וֹם אִתִּ֑י וְנִצַּבְתָּ֖ עַל־ הַצּֽוּר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh hin·nêh mā·qō·wm ’it·tî wə·niṣ·ṣaḇ·tā ‘al- haṣ·ṣūr
verses.literal: The LORD continued There is a place near Me where you are to stand upon a rock
verses.literalPt: Disse mais Jeová: Eis aqui está um lugar perto de mim, e tu estarás sobre a penha.

verses.original: וְהָיָה֙ בַּעֲבֹ֣ר כְּבֹדִ֔י וְשַׂמְתִּ֖יךָ בְּנִקְרַ֣ת הַצּ֑וּר וְשַׂכֹּתִ֥י כַפִּ֛י עָלֶ֖יךָ עַד־ עָבְרִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh ba·‘ă·ḇōr kə·ḇō·ḏî wə·śam·tî·ḵā bə·niq·raṯ haṣ·ṣūr wə·śak·kō·ṯî ḵap·pî ‘ā·le·ḵā ‘aḏ- ‘ā·ḇə·rî
verses.literal: and when My glory passes by I will put you in a cleft of the rock and cover you with My hand . . . until I have passed by
verses.literalPt: Quando passar a minha glória, te porei numa fenda da penha e te cobrirei com a mão, até que eu tenha passado.

verses.original: וַהֲסִרֹתִי֙ אֶת־ כַּפִּ֔י וְרָאִ֖יתָ אֶת־ אֲחֹרָ֑י וּפָנַ֖י לֹ֥א יֵרָאֽוּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: wa·hă·si·rō·ṯî ’eṯ- kap·pî wə·rā·’î·ṯā ’eṯ- ’ă·ḥō·rāy ū·p̄ā·nay lō yê·rā·’ū
verses.literal: Then I will take My hand away and you will see My back but My face must not be seen
verses.literalPt: Depois, tirarei a mão, e me verás pelas costas; porém a minha face não se verá.
